title: NANPA annual-report references for NPAs 325 and 331

data.notes: Authoritative NANPA material lists Texas NPA 325 and the Illinois 331/630 overlay. Historical NANPA planning material identifies 325 as the 915 split and PL-362 identifies 331 as overlaying 630. These are current U.S. geographic NPA seeds; arithmetic alone was not used to admit candidates.

NANPA PL-626 identifies NPA 334 as the existing Alabama geographic NPA serving Montgomery, Dothan, Auburn, Prattville, Phenix City, Enterprise, Opelika, Selma and surrounding communities, with 483 overlay relief entering service in 2026.

title: Aurora Community Fridge current public hub

title: Aurora Mutual Aid public social activity mirror

data.notes: Public mirror preserves Aurora Mutual Aid / Aurora Ayuda Mutua activity through March 2024 and its self-description of mutual aid as direct action, cooperation and solidarity rather than charity, outside unjust systems of power. Current first-party site says Clarke Street Fund generates and distributes funds for sustainability and revitalization of Black communities in Alabama, centers food sovereignty/community regeneration, and identifies FreshGreens Market under 'Who we fund'. data.research_question: Which public organizations relevant to the anarchist-violence organization-enumeration corpus are discoverable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 325, 331 and 334?
data.method: Bounded area-code organization enumeration using authoritative NANPA admission, deterministic NPA mod 3 sharding, literal anarchist/ABC/Food Not Bombs/mutual-aid queries, locality-derived queries, current first-party/public organization surfaces, public social hubs and historical directories only as discovery seeds; repository exact-name search used before creation.
classification_rules: Do not infer individual political affiliation from organization proximity or event participation.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level evidence.
Historical directories and old social endpoints are discovery seeds until current status is corroborated.
Do not merge identities from name or handle similarity alone.
Completed NPAs are not repeated without materially new evidence.

findings.notes: Abilene Pride Alliance has current mutual-aid programs and exact public Facebook/Instagram endpoints. Abilene Community Fridge is current in a local service directory; its 2021 Instagram endpoint remains status-unresolved.
Aurora Mutual Aid is corroborated by a current public community-fridge hub and preserved recent public social activity. Project and organization identities remain distinct.

Clarke Street Fund, FreshGreens Market and Montgomery 50501 Freedom Fighters have current/recent public evidence; Clarke Street Fund explicitly supports FreshGreens Market and is externally characterized as advancing mutual aid.
